name: Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam International Airport

runway.v: one runway, 14/32, 3,040 m × 45 m; 3,370 m × 45 m for take-off from runway 14 when the starter extension is used (TORA 3,370 m with starter extension) (AIP footnote: "** These figures include the Starter Extension.")

hours.v: air traffic services H24; aerodrome administration office Mon-Fri 04:45-12:00 UTC (08:45-16:00 local), closed weekends and holidays

fuel.quote: Jet A1, Turbo Oil 2380, ASTO 390, Skydrol 500B

notes: Sources: DCA Mauritius AIP AD 2-FIMP page dated 21 APR 22 (AMDT 01/22) and the DCA eAIP package labelled 12_11_2024_updated (AD 2 FIMP page, no effective date shown on the page); both agree on runway and fuel. A newer DCA eAIP edition dated 2025-05-15 (Non-AIRAC AMDT 1-25) exists but could not be opened: https://civil-aviation.govmu.org/eAIP/eAIPMauritius/final/2025-05-15/html/cover-en-GB.html (site error). Customs and immigration are given as "HO" (ICAO: service available to meet operational requirements), not as fixed hours, so customs was not recorded. No night curfew, PPR or slot rule appears in the AD 2 text read, but the AIP does not say explicitly that there is none, so curfew is left out. Quotes come from a summarising fetch tool and may need checking against the PDF. Local time is UTC+4 (no DST). | 2026-11-02 run: read DCA eAIP AD 2 FIMP html (2024 package, 12_11_2024_updated) incl. AD 2.20 and AD 2.21: customs/immigration "HO" only (not fixed hours); AD 2.21 noise abatement "NIL"; no PPR, slot, curfew or night-ban text found, and absence is not stated, so those stay missing. AD 2.20 local rules: turning pads mandatory for Code D and above; helicopters VMC daylight only (not a fixed-wing restriction). Newer 2025 edition still not opened. 5 Nov 2026: 2026-11-05 run: a newer eAIP edition exists, labelled 2026-07-23-Extended (AD 1.1 opened, no edition date on it and nothing on FIMP hours or night); its AD 2 FIMP and GEN 1.2 pages were refused. For the owner's review only, not recorded as a rule because a newer edition is unread: AIP GEN 1.2 (AMDT 01/24, 18 JUL 24), agreeing with the Nov 2024 eAIP package, says 'Prior permission is necessary for airlines operating Charter / Special flights to Mauritius.', application 'at least 7 days in advance of the intended landing'; private flights apply 'not less than 10 hours from the time of flight' and 'No private aircraft shall take off for Mauritius until a flight clearance is granted by the Department of Civil Aviation.' MRA customs page failed. | 7 Nov 2026: nothing new verified. Search found no 2026 eAIP FIMP page on civil-aviation.govmu.org (only the Nov 2024 package and older PDFs); a 2025-05-15 Non-AIRAC AMDT 1-25 PDF appears only on a contractor's domain (aeronauticaldesignlabs.com), not cited. No Airports of Mauritius page found by search.
